{{Quote|I've tagged Fli'teri and Jinmin Tokati for the Kothlis inquiries. If either calls back, let them know I'll be in touch later tonight.|Bail Organa, to Minala Lodilyn|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Jinmin Tokati''' was an individual who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], following the outbreak of a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] tasked Tokati and [[Fli'teri]] with undertaking enquiries in relation to the battle for him.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth" />
